# Apex HR

Apex HR is a global HR, recruitment and people-consulting partner for employers, headquartered in London and serving employers across Africa, North America, Europe and the Middle East. The company is employer-first, combining outsourced HR support, recruitment and talent acquisition, and strategic workforce advisory in one connected service — with a secondary, clearly separated pathway for candidates (job search and the Apex talent pool).

Reach us on WhatsApp: +44 7762 272692
Email: hello@apexhrllc.com
Website: https://www.apexhrllc.com
